title: GenerateReportRequest
description: Shared request shape for both GENERATE_PDF_REPORT and GENERATE_EXCEL_REPORT. The engine re-runs the full analysis pipeline from these inputs rather than accepting a previously-computed AnalyzeStackupResponse, so the report always reflects the current component/equation state.

outputPath.description: Absolute filesystem path the engine writes the file to directly (PDF or XLSX depending on which envelope type was used). The file is NOT returned as base64 in the response — both processes run on the same machine, so writing straight to disk avoids inflating the JSON payload with a binary blob.
